title: Connector allowlist
description: `connectors/<name>/allowlist.yaml` in the tool gateway (ADR 0014). Turns operations of the connector's `openapi.yaml` into MCP tools. Only listed tools exist, and each exposes only its listed arguments, under the API's own parameter names (path, query and body properties). Rules run before the call, then the hook if named; a hook cannot widen what the rules allow. Rules not expressible here, checked by the gateway at load: every tool name starts with `<connector>.`, every `operation` and `hook_operations` entry is an operationId in openapi.yaml, every listed argument is a parameter or body property of that operation (hook arguments must not be), every `{name}` in a check is a listed or fixed argument, every hook exists in hooks.py.

connector.description: Connector name, the prefix of its tool names.

base_url.description: API base URL the operation paths are joined to.

credentials.description: Credential kind per acts_as. A missing key means that acts_as cannot use this connector.

hook_operations.description: operationIds hooks may call in addition to the tool's own (for example listing labels). Anything else is refused.

description.description: Tool description for the model; defaults to the operation's summary.

arguments.description: The arguments the model may pass, by API parameter name, each with its rules ({} for none). Unlisted parameters do not exist for the model.

fixed.description: Parameters always sent with this value and hidden from the model (for example state: closed).

checks.description: Checks on a value built from the arguments, for example {owner}/{repo} in the allowed repos.

annotations.description: MCP tool annotations. The worker reads readOnlyHint as read_only and idempotentHint as idempotent (ADR 0013); set them only if true, a repeat after a crash relies on them.

hook.description: Function in hooks.py run around the call, for checks that need extra calls.

hook_arguments.description: Extra arguments only the hook reads (for example duplicate_of), each a JSON Schema shown to the model.

refuse_pattern.description: Regular expression; a matching value is refused with refuse_message.

refuse_message.description: Shown to the model; must not reveal settings.

append.description: Literal text added to the value (for example " is:issue").

scope_qualifiers.description: Appends `<qualifier>:<value>` for each value of a gateway setting (search kept inside the allowed repos).

value.description: Template over argument names, for example "{owner}/{repo}".

message.description: Shown to the model when the check fails; {value} is replaced.

result.description: What of the API response reaches the model. Without it, the whole response does (avoid).

list.description: Path to a list in the response (`.` when the response is the list); fields then apply to each item.

fields.description: Output name to source path (`a.b`, `labels[].name` for a list of names).

settingName.description: Name of a gateway setting (environment variable) holding a comma-separated list.
